question: Will we be able to reach anyone back home once we're deep in the wilderness?

hops.text: There is no cell service past Ashby Lake. Once you leave Ashby Lake, assume you cannot call, text or load a map. Download maps before you leave, and tell someone at home your route and expected exit date. If you want a way to call for help, rent a satellite messenger with your gear

notes: No shared key words. A full answer gives both the bad news and the satellite messenger.
